summary: Late at night, Neo walks alone down a rain-soaked city street, feeling watched as headlights appear behind him. A car slides to a stop beside him on the bridge and its back door opens; Trinity, inside, tells him to get in.

what_changes.before: Alone and exposed on the street, where everything feels unsafe and every pair of eyes seems to follow him.
what_changes.after: A car stops beside him and its back door opens, offering escape or capture.

what_changes.evidence: The back door opens. TRINITY Get in.
